title: Openers: 4x2min uphill, last sharpener before travel
terrain: treadmill or real hill, 8-10% incline, no descent (walk down if outdoors)
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 4x2min uphill at 153-162bpm, moderately hard, not max, with 2min walk recovery between reps. Walk down if outdoors, no running descent. 12min warmup, 10min cooldown flat.
GYM: none.
FUEL: normal, no gel needed for 36min.
STOP RULE: any lateral knee signal ends the rep, don't push through to the next one.
WHY: last quality touch before Wednesday's travel to Sofia. 4 days out there is no fitness left to gain, this is a primer to keep the legs sharp without banking residual fatigue into the travel block. Max intensity was already spent 1 Sep (188bpm ladder) - this is deliberately sub-maximal.
